item.title: No Prisoners, Right?
item.description: A tense standoff pulls the crew into the tangled politics of a galaxy struggling under Imperial rule. What begins as a simple job quickly spirals into blaster fire, uneasy alliances, and questions about who truly owns the secrets everyone is willing to fight over. As rival factions circle and loyalties grow uncertain, the team must rely on quick thinking, careful diplomacy, and a little improvisation to survive the fallout. In a time when truth is hard to find and trust is even harder to earn, every choice risks drawing the wrong kind of attention.

item.description: After a vicious fight on the desert planet of FLORUM, the crew retreat to the ship and slip back into hyperspace. Blasted and bruised, but still alive, the crew have to decide where do they go from there? Redemption is: Chris Burlew as the GM, and also the droids 1-1-D4 and R3-A1 Andi Fox as the Bothan negotiator , Quinth Kaylee Jung as the Jedi, Karrell Michael Waldschlager II as the Duros pilot, Tazi. May Coker as the Zeltron Enforcer, Zhaan Nathan Robinson as the Nautolan Gunner, Kaio Tracy Gibbons (https://www.twitch.tv/tracysaur) and Timothy Gray as our narrators. Editor and Produced by Kaylee Jung and Chris Burlew. As well as so many wonderful guest stars over the past 8 years. Thank you all.

item.title: The Lost Episodes – Part 9
item.description:
Some of you have asked for it, and it's been over 5 years coming. So here is raw / remastered audio of our first recorded game sessions. It's 4 people around a table with no audio treatments, a Blue Yeti mic and a lot of cluelessness in recording podcasts and even playing the FFG Star Wars game. But there is history and humor and ... well, this is one of the bonus episodes y'all get for being such amazing fans.

NEW FOLKS TO THE SHOW: Please note - this is not indicative of our audio quality. We learned fast :D

item.title: One Player Game – Part 2
item.description:
Here is the second episode of the bonus one player game that our GM Chris recorded. Chris was joined by Kyle from the wonderful podcasts Tavern Tales, Tavern Tales Jr., and Flight Risk. In this game Kyle and Chris took turns in the GM chair, and due to the design of this game neither of them could have predicted the ups and downs of the last scene. After you have listened to this episode, please reach out to us to discuss the game flow, and the slight modifications in the rules. We would love to hear your feedback. 

 

Contact: 

Kyle Gould @taverntalesdm  or www.taverntales.ca/Kyle

Chris @burlew_chris or @redemptionpod

 

Also, reach out to us to join the Redemption Podcast Discord channel where you can meet and interact with other great fans of Star Wars stories.
